Paste an image for an expiring link with no account, or make one HTTPS request from your app. Capture full pages or viewports in PNG, JPEG, or WebP; render Letter, A4, or Legal PDFs; and control expiry and storage. Built for developers and AI agents with OpenAPI 3.1 docs, predictable errors, explicit rate limits, and a generous free plan.

posts.name: City Pulse
posts.tagline: Find local demand in Telegram chats before it goes cold
posts.description: Global Pulse turns natural-language searches across city Telegram chats into relevant local results and business alerts. Launching first in Nha Trang for services, rentals, real estate, tours, repairs, delivery, health, beauty, sellers, tourists, expats, and new residents.

posts.name: Buply
posts.tagline: Reunite lost pets using noseprints
posts.description: Buply is pet safety app that creates a virtual ID for your pet by scanning its unique noseprint (like a fingerprint). Owners can build a detailed profile (breed, color, traits, medical history), and the community can help reunite lost pets by scanning and contacting the owner. We’re starting with dogs (live) and cats (upcoming), and we’re building toward a complete pet platform: safety, health info, adoption, and nearby services — all in one place.

posts.name: Email Validator API
posts.tagline: Stop fake emails from breaking your signup flow
posts.description: Validate any email in real time with a 3-step check: syntax, MX record, and SMTP handshake. No email sent — we verify the mailbox actually exists. Catches typos (gmial.com), disposable domains (mailinator), and dead addresses before they hit your database. Free tier: 1,000 validations/month. No API key. Pure Python, GDPR-friendly.

posts.name: Prompt Jugaad
posts.tagline: Free AI Prompts. Copy, Try, Create.
posts.description: Discover a free library of curated AI prompts for ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and AI image generators. Browse by category, copy prompts instantly, and try them with your favorite AI. From viral image prompts and creative experiments to productivity and developer workflows, Prompt Jugaad makes finding useful prompts simple.

posts.name: Speedstand
posts.tagline: The ultimate data hub for Formula 1 fans
posts.description: F1 is more than just the race. Speedstand is an independent F1 data hub for fans who love exploring the details behind the sport. Follow race weekends, explore driver and team stats, dive into telemetry and strategy, and discover more about every circuit — all in one clean, focused app.

posts.name: FreeTokens by Lovie
posts.tagline: Get 300+ AI models through one free local API key
posts.description: FreeTokens is a free, open-source desktop agent that helps you access legitimate free tiers from 24 AI providers and use 300+ models through one OpenAI-compatible local API. It automates repetitive signup steps, pauses for CAPTCHAs or verification, stores every key securely on your machine, and works with tools like Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Aider, and Cline.

posts.name: AI Bytes
posts.tagline: Daily AI News tailored for your role
posts.description: Hi, I'm Sushmita - a full-time PM, building this on weekends and evenings. AI news is everywhere, but it's buried in the algorithm, same 10 links in every newsletter, telling nobody what to actually do about it. So I built AI Bytes: a 2-min daily AI briefing that's different per role (Dev, PM, Marketer - more soon). Each story comes with "what this means for you" + one action item. 🎯 Different stories per role ⚡ Fully automated 📰 Pulls from 15+ sources daily

posts.name: oxpecker
posts.tagline: know which of your lines a vendor just broke
posts.description: Six products will tell you Stripe changed. oxpecker tells you which of your lines it broke — on the pull request, before the sunset date. 26 vendors watched; your source never leaves your CI.

posts.name: Sound Tester
posts.tagline: Test Speakers, Headphones & Microphones Online
posts.description: Test your speakers, headphones, microphone, stereo sound, bass, frequency, and audio latency online for free with Sound Tester. No download required

posts.name: Claude Code CLI Proxy
posts.tagline: Convert claude desktop as API and save extra API credits.
posts.description: If you’re using Claude Code with a subscription, but also paying separately for LLM API keys to power your agents or applications… you might be paying twice. 👀 I built claude-cli-proxy to turn your locally authenticated Claude Code CLI into a local API server. So your existing agents, SDKs and applications can use Claude through: http://127.0.0.1:7274 No separate API key. No additional per-token API billing. Just use the Claude Code subscription you already have. Try it:npx claude-cli-proxy

posts.name: EstateDeck
posts.tagline: Property Management Software built for Indian landlords
posts.description: EstateDeck is property management software built in India for landlords, housing societies, gated communities and commercial property managers. It runs rent and maintenance collection over UPI, automates visitor entry at the gate, tracks maintenance tickets, handles amenity bookings, and exports finances to Tally.

posts.name: RMDialer Auto Dialer & Telecalling App
posts.tagline: Auto Dialer, CRM Dialer & Telecalling Software for Android
posts.description: RMDialer is an Auto Dialer, CRM Dialer and telecalling software in one Android app. Leads flow in from Facebook, portals, Google Sheets and Excel, auto-assign round robin, and the Auto Dialer calls each rep's queue from their own SIM: real numbers, no VoIP. When a call ends: status + remark in 2 taps, WhatsApp follow-up sends itself, and managers watch the whole team on a live web dashboard. Offline-first, dual SIM, 40 languages. Free 3-day trial, no credit card required.

posts.name: ACN
posts.tagline: Open-source infrastructure for AI agents to collaborate
posts.description: ACN is open-source infrastructure that lets AI agents discover each other, talk over the A2A protocol, share a task pool, and settle payments with AP2. Self-host with Docker in minutes. Python, TypeScript and CLI SDKs included.⁠

posts.name: VinAudit Data
posts.tagline: One API for vehicle data, history, market value, images
posts.description: VinAudit Data is a unified automotive data platform for developers, startups, dealers, marketplaces, lenders and insurers. Access VIN decoding, specs, market listings, valuations, NMVTIS-backed vehicle history, images and monitoring through one API. Cover the U.S. and Canada without stitching together multiple data providers. Start a free trial!

posts.name: Contour Music
posts.tagline: Discover music, compare taste, and see what's actually big
posts.description: Discover your next favorite song with a feed that learns your taste from every track you rate. Features include ratings, personal taste-metrics, written reviews, era-adjusted streaming charts and side-by-side comparisons.

posts.name: Forkit
posts.tagline: Turn ideas into real, shareable AI-built products
posts.description: Buildfork turns an idea into a real product with AI. Create websites, games, images, and music with built-in user login, databases, and shared spaces. Preview and publish instantly, share your complete creation process, sell what you make, or remix products created by others.

posts.name: JobJitsu
posts.tagline: Nail your next interview
posts.description: An AI interviewer that researches your company, reads your CV, and interviews you out loud for 30 minutes — 8-12 questions built for the role, with real follow-ups when an answer is thin. Minutes after you hang up: a score out of 10, feedback on every answer, a stronger rewrite of your weakest ones, and the 3 things to fix before the real one. First interview free — no account, no card. One-time packs after that, no subscription. Audio is never stored, only the transcript.
